■ Charisma Star Max Evolution: When you would lose the game or this creature would leave, you may destroy 3 of your face up cards or put one of your shields into your graveyard instead. (This creature doesn't need an evolution source. If you have 2 or more Star Max Evolution Creatures, one of them stays and return the rest of your hand.)
Mach Fighter Slayer Double Breaker
 Oniend: After this creature attacks, if a player has no shields, untap this creature.
